decisions.statement: Keep project execution governance in a versioned project-control directory, separate from the Agent Native framework runtime.
decisions.rationale: The project needs durable checkpoints and machine-readable progress without turning project management into part of the product architecture.
decisions.revisit_when: The project requires shared multi-repository orchestration.

decisions.statement: Use JSON for machine-readable control-plane contracts and Python standard library for validation.
decisions.rationale: Avoid new runtime dependencies and make validation available in a clean Python environment.
evidence: No package/dependency baseline is assumed for this control-plane bootstrap
decisions.revisit_when: Schema complexity or concurrent writers justify a dedicated schema tool or service.
